column1: # Super Admin has full platform access
# Admin can act as account admin on platform
# Account Admin inherits all lower roles within the same personal team
# Event Manager inherits Team Member within the same personal team
# Account Admin inherits all lower roles within the same institution team
# Event Manager inherits Team Member within the same institution team
# If Caroline is assigned as account_admin for KCA:
# She does NOT get permissions for any other institution!
# If Allan is assigned as event_manager for his personal team:
# ✅ event_manager permissions for his personal team
# ✅ team_member permissions for his personal team
# He does NOT get account_admin permissions!
